The 430-line adapter owns WorkOS membership and invitation wire interpretation and current role mapping. This slice adds short exact-ID deletion and raw membership readers (1–4 paths). Moving individual methods solely for the line threshold would divide the same provider contract and expand the rebase; retain the cohesive adapter.
One live evidence driver compares application reads with provider facts; its proof boundaries stay adjacent.
One live site/driver owns server diagnostics, browser actions, and credential-safe observations.
One real-package integration composition supports a matrix of provider administration results, rather than separate duplicated sites per result.
One browser/MCP integration composition checks organization selection and current role access through the same fixtures.
One fake directory owns related membership/role routes over the same provider state.
The double keeps the SDK-shaped state and the methods that change or observe it together.

The member contract suite keeps independent management-evidence, grant, revision and malformed-page cases with one scoped SDK double. Deletion outcomes are already in their own file. A further threshold-only split would scatter the remaining read contract.
One current-membership contract matrix covers permissions, complete pages, and failure behavior.
One provider access-resolution matrix keeps its no-write boundary and exact query observations together.
